name: minigraf_retract
description: Record that a fact in Minigraf's graph memory is no longer true. By default this closes the fact's valid window at now (or at valid_at): it leaves the current view, and :valid-at queries inside the window still see it. Use mode "correct" only for a fact that was recorded in error — that erases it from valid-time history, leaving it visible only to :as-of.

reason.description: Why this fact is being retracted. Forces you to justify the removal.

valid_at.description: Optional. When the fact stopped being true in the world, if not now -- e.g. the date a decision was superseded. YYYY-MM-DD or an ISO 8601 datetime; past or present, after the fact's own valid-from. A '; valid-at: <date>' line in facts is read the same way. Not allowed with mode "correct".

mode.description: Optional, default "close": the fact stopped being true; end its valid window and keep its history. Each fact must be a literal [entity attribute value] triple that is currently live. "correct": the fact was recorded in error; withdraw it outright.
